page_title: BET 5-1 VLL | Betis v Valladolid 24/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.

90+4' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
90+2' Valladolid fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 5 - 1 Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Andre Ferreira with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 5:1.
87' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) gets inside the box and tries to beat Andre Ferreira with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
84' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Cucho Hernandez tees up Romain Perraud (Betis) inside the box and he curls the ball into the right side of the net and past Andre Ferreira.
83' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
83' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Betis have a corner.
83' Antony (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
83' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Corner kick. Betis will have an opportunity.
80' Substitution. Isco walks off the pitch and William Carvalho (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
80' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Valladolid.
77' The attendance is 46458.
74' A pass by Darwin Machis (Valladolid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
72' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
71' Alvaro Rubio has decided to substitute Stanko Juric and he is replaced by Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid).
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mamadou Sylla (Valladolid) comes onto the pitch for Selim Amallah.
70' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
69' Isco (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
69' Antony (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
66' 3 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Aitor Ruibal, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Isco (Betis), who beats Andre Ferreira with a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. 3:1.
64' 2 - 1 Goal! Marc Bartra gets to the by-line and sends in a lofted ball. Cucho Hernandez (Betis) climbs highest and powers a close-range header into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jesus Rodriguez leaves the pitch and Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) comes on.
61' It will be a substitution. Romain Perraud (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Ricardo Rodriguez walks off.
61' Substitution. Aitor Ruibal (Betis) on for Youssouf Sabaly.
60' Alvaro Rubio decides to make a substitution. Raul Moro will be replaced by Darwin Machis (Valladolid).
60' The referee allows time for a substitution. Anuar will be replaced by Mario Martin (Valladolid).
57' Isco (Betis) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
55' Referee Francisco Maeso seems to have made up his mind after reviewing the incident using VAR, and no action will be taken against Natan (Betis).

53' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Natan (Betis), but referee Francisco Maeso must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
51' Raul Moro (Valladolid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

49' Betis slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) comes on the pitch for Pablo Fornals.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' None of the Valladolid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

45+5' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Valladolid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+4' A snap shot by Luis Perez (Valladolid) from the edge of the area flies towards the roof of the net, but Adrian produces a good save to thwart him. Valladolid win a corner.
45+2' Valladolid enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Anuar (Valladolid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
41' 1 - 1 GOAL! Chuki (Valladolid) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:1.

38' Antony (Betis) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Valladolid will have a goal kick.
36' Anuar (Valladolid) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
34' Isco (Betis) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
33' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Now Betis have a corner.
33' Valladolid fail to score from a corner as Adrian (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
32' The ball is cleared after Raul Moro (Valladolid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Valladolid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
31' Isco (Betis) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valladolid.
30' PENALTY APPEAL after Adam Aznou (Valladolid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
27' Pablo Fornals (Betis) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
24' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Adrian is alert and denies him.
22' The ratio of the ball possession is 68:32.
20' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

17' 1 - 0 What a wonderful finish! Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
16' Antony (Betis) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' Natan (Betis) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
11' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes.
8' Javier Sanchez is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Joseph Aidoo (Valladolid).
6' Javier Sanchez (Valladolid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

3' Raul Moro (Valladolid) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Adrian.
2' Foul! Adam Aznou (Valladolid) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Francisco Maeso will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
